#!/bin/bash

# Find broken symbolic links in the workspace directory
find /tmp/mcp-workspace -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -print > /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt

# Count how many were found
count=$(wc -l < /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt)

echo "Found $count broken symbolic links."
if [ $count -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "Broken links:"
  cat /tmp/mcp-workspace/broken_links.txt
else
  echo "No broken symbolic links found."
fi
